verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack says who absorbs ACH return fraud, card dispute, or account takeover losses, and there is no documented liability split between Column and its platform customers. The pack has a few control-adjacent features: ACH account-number permissions and limits, custom roles, KYC/KYB verification and transfer holds. None of these are tied to fraud-loss allocation, so the core of the story is unevidenced.
